body.x: DROGEN (CEO Lee Heung-sin, www.lobit.co.kr) showcased its representative sports drones “LOBIT320” and “LOBIT300” in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
The domestic sports drone market is still in the early stage, but the industry is already taking center stage as a promising future field in the U.S. and European regions.

After over two years of development, DROGEN introduced its world-class sports drones “LOBIT320” and “LOBIT300” at CES 2016. They are finished products, so anyone can easily enter the incredible world of drones.

The “Lobit 320” is an FPV sports drone with six propellers. With a maximum speed of 130 km per hour, it possesses various aerobatic flight functions, and is equipped with a coaxial system and a power motor that can endure strong wind speeds.

The “Lobit 300” is a sports drone for FPV racing. With a maximum speed of 120 km per hour, it is made of carbon frames, making it highly durable. It is equipped with a highly efficient BLDC motor that the company developed. The main characteristic is its refined and stylish aeromechanical canopy with high maneuverability, and a stable design based on center of gravity.

DROGEN CEO Lee Heung-sin said: “At this CES 2016, we will focus on promoting the excellence of the sports drone LOBIT to the global market. We are discussing a plan with an American drone developer to establish a joint corporation in the U.S. And we will accelerate our online sales in the U.S.”

For its drone production, DROGEN has successfully developed its own mainboards, firmware, motors, propellers, frames, and canopies. It is currently developing new frames (100~600mm), PCB, F/C, 2207, 2204, and 1806 BLDC motors, as well as ROS technology. After starting exports to Japan in July last year, the company will provide its products to other foreign markets, including the U.S., China and Australia.

To keep pace with the expanding drone market for beginners, the company will showcase low-priced drones that can be freely customized and transformed in an open source platform. It will combine various new technologies, and its competitiveness will strengthen through localization and use of cheaper special materials.

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the infrastructure project of smart drone application technology for security and convenience services. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
